On Wednesday, December 11, 2013 at 10:58:22 AM UTC-5, gjabel wrote:
solved, for future others...

output$downloadmap <- downloadHandler(
    "map.png" ,
    content = function(file) {
      print(g1, file="g1.html") #g1 is the googlemap object, stored earlier from g1<<-gvisAreaChart(...
      system("wkhtmltoimage -n --enable-javascript --javascript-delay 2000 g1.html g1.png ")
      file.copy("g1.png", file)
    }
  )
